scope: Exploratory frozen-output relation-head transfer and abstention probe
target: observed-only TrackCraft t0 plus same-query full-video TrackCraft future displacement
primary_model: history odd edge MLP and component-zero-mean graph integration
control_model: parameter-matched node residual MLP with zero-mean correction
abstention_gate: 0.25 if mean edge-vector distance between baseline future and observed t0 is >= median of four development videos; else 0
descriptive_transfer_criterion: On both videos, edge-abstention must improve both structural metrics relative to g=0 baseline and raw ADE may not rise >5%; compare paired node residual by video. Two-video outcome does not establish generalization.
known_limits: Transfer data use a different DA3 spatial resolution and domain
PointOdyssey pseudo-labels and DA3 inputs previously investigated; not a pristine test set
Existing PointOdyssey DA3 was reconstructed from 22 frames; future-context contamination prevents an RGB observed-only claim
TrackCraft3R full-video future displacements are proxy labels, not true trajectory ground truth
